annotations.title: Take an agent off a number

description: Stop an agent answering a number: a forwarded number goes back to Hermoso's call handling; a number imported into the platform is removed from it (the number stays on the carrier account). Without confirm:true nothing changes and the answer says what would. Free. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected
